reference.kind: supplied Touhou 6 v1.02h executable under isolated Wine
reference.asset_policy: Original EXE, archives, MIDI, WAV and extracted data remain outside the repository.

demo00.kind: Real original Replay-menu execution, first replay session only
demo00.scope: Original replay frames 1..3720; initial stage4 music request at frame -1. Native trace works without an audio device.
demo00.output_boundary: Wine run has no physical DirectSound output device. SFX_REQUEST and BGM_REQUEST are actual EXE calls; this does not claim speaker PCM identity or a full-game audio event comparison.

midi.method: Actual EXE ParseFile, LoadTracks, OnTimerElapsed and SetFadeOut on isolated objects; only MIDI device send boundary records messages. Port production Sequence scheduler receives identical callbacks.
midi.compared: All callback IDs, short/sysex bytes and message order; every callback tempo and tick counters included in rolling hashes.
midi.limitation: Event/tempo/loop/fade identity does not establish Windows GM.dls timbre. The browser uses a declared freely licensed General MIDI SoundFont fallback.

wave_queue_fade.method: Actual EXE PlaySoundByIdx, PlaySounds, SoundPlayer::FadeOut and CStreamingSound::UpdateFadeOut on isolated objects, recording the DirectSound COM call boundary.
assertions: Repeated requests coalesce by voice index; overflow drops after three distinct voices.
Replay of a voice calls Stop, SetCurrentPosition(0), Play in this order.
Muting skips flush and retains queued voices, matching original behavior.
All 32 source file selections and dB100 gains match.
Every fade tick and terminal Stop matches for eight durations.
wave_queue_fade.command: TH06_AUDIO_REFERENCE_DIR=<private evidence directory> cargo test -p th06-engine --lib matches_executable_queue -- --nocapture

pcm_loops.method: Production native WAV/Ogg decoder and LoopSource: compare 256 samples before source loop end and 768 following samples against decoded PCM at source loop start. Original POS points and 44.1kHz source rate preserved.
pcm_loops.command: TH06_AUDIO_REFERENCE_DIR=<private evidence directory> cargo test -p th06-engine --release --lib supplied_wav_and_ogg_pcm -- --nocapture
pcm_loops.browser_scope: 34 offline WebAudio cases: 17 tracks at 44100 and 48000 Hz outputs, loop alignment checked against decoded buffers.
pcm_loops.limitation: Ogg is the hosted lossy encoding. The test establishes loop position/sample continuity for that decoded source, not bitwise identity with the original WAV.

source_backed_fixes: Pickup SoundIdx21 emitted once after the full item loop.
Enemy ECL sound requests precede same-tick player-hit feedback.
Stage entry requests music before the first replay tick; title attract demo preserves title music.
Initial BGM gain restored to original 0dB (1.0).
Repeated PlayAudio requests restart the same track from the intro, including Music Room confirmation.
Explicit StopAudio when GameManager is removed, preserving the attract-demo exception.
coverage_boundary: This receipt covers the listed actual-executable scenarios and isolated function probes. Other predefined scenario results belong in their own receipts; no universal full-game audio equivalence claim is made.

menu_scenarios.method: Real keyboard input intervals in seven private original/Wine copies; native receives the same intervals. Comparison preserves total SFX/BGM ordering within each Present, including simultaneous LEFT+RIGHT and Z+X. Original startup before Present230 is excluded in both traces.

options-defaults.scope: Options values only; excludes title/startup pixels and Windows device recreation.

options-ranges.scope: Options values only; excludes title/startup pixels and Windows device recreation.

options-repeat.scope: Options values only; excludes title/startup pixels and Windows device recreation.

corrections: Shift-JIS trail byte0x40 inside description lines no longer splits a fake track.
Options selection sound precedes each corresponding music stop/play request.
Music Room return requests title music on the next Supervisor calculation.
Simultaneous Music Room confirmation+return plays the chosen track before returning.
menu_scenarios.limitation: Actual EXE requests are verified. Wine has no physical DirectSound output device; buffer scheduling/gains/fades are covered separately by the isolated real-function probe.
menu_scenarios.entry_protocol: Same original keyboard intervals, including Q180 to leave PRE_INPUT. Original Present p corresponds to completed port update p+1.

independent_present_crosscheck.scope: Independent fixed entry convention: original first replay-frame1 Present from its state CSV, native direct replay first calculation atPresent0.
